services.name: Venue rental
services.desc: Looking to host an event in Hilo? From small family gatherings to large corporate events, ‘Imiloa offers a unique environment able to accommodate your every need. Create an evening that might include a planetarium show plus dinner or start the day with a breakfast meeting by renting our classroom. You might even consider a large corporate event utilizing the entire facility. Rent our facility and host your event today: weddings, birthday parties, anniversaries & reunions, proms and more! Technical capabilities include Internet connectivity, LCD projectors and screen. We also provide speaker's podium and some audio capability including lavalieres and hard-wired microphones.
